reviews.summary: Reviewed the complete cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness against all eight Delta units and the relevant formal-model contracts. The seven authorized edits reconstruct the committed sources exactly (src/core/templates/workflows/explore.ts:32-35; src/core/templates/workflows/propose.ts:75,114), the frozen candidate prompts match the tracked generated surfaces, and the independently rerun 19 template/installation suites passed all 246 tests. The raw dialogues substantiate their reported bounded conversational outcomes, but required active investigation and consequential-feasibility handling lack behavior evidence. This is a verification failure, not an observed failure of the approved wording. HEAD remained unchanged and the project worktree remained clean.
findings: CRITICAL — Completeness/Correctness, G1 verification: active investigation of discoverable project facts is required by .xirang/changes/intent-solution-feasibility/tasks.md:3-5 and elements/explore-brainstorming.md:26, and implemented in src/core/templates/workflows/explore.ts:33. However, .xirang/changes/intent-solution-feasibility/evidence/dialogue-workflow.js:3-22 supplies the repository facts in user messages, and line 32 expressly prohibits every command except reading the frozen prompt. evidence/verification.md:42 confirms that actual project investigation was not exercised. The existing string checks in test/core/templates/explore-template.test.ts:16-29 do not establish investigation behavior. An Agent that always asks the user for readily available repository facts would still pass this experiment. Add bounded one-time behavior evidence with discoverable project facts and permitted read-only tools, retaining the actual calls and responses so the required investigation can be assessed; a new persistent test or a complete workflow replay is unnecessary.

CRITICAL — Completeness/Correctness, G2 verification: the changed feasibility policy requires delegation before confirming dependent design when consequential uncertainty remains, and disclosure of remaining uncertainty and its decision impact when execution is blocked or inconclusive (.xirang/changes/intent-solution-feasibility/elements/explore.md:25-29; src/core/templates/workflows/explore.ts:35). The sole experiment prohibits delegation (evidence/dialogue-workflow.js:32); its evidence scenario supplies a successful local result and a logical contradiction (lines 8-12), but no blocked or inconclusive execution result. evidence/verification.md:42 explicitly confirms that Experimenter delegation was not exercised. Inspection of every input in evidence/dialogues.json found no blocked/inconclusive execution case; the recorded result objects contain no tool/delegation trace. Also, git grep -n -E 'not every design needs|consequential feasibility|execution is blocked|results are inconclusive|Investigate facts available' HEAD -- test returned no matches. The evidence therefore cannot reject an Agent that never delegates unresolved feasibility questions or incorrectly treats a blocked experiment as resolved. Add a bounded one-time case permitting an observable Experimenter handoff and result consumption, including a blocked or inconclusive result; verify that dependent design is not prematurely confirmed and the remaining uncertainty and decision impact are explained. Existing sufficient-evidence dialogues already cover the no-new-experiment branch.

reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change for Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness against all eight Semantic Delta units and the applicable formal model. The seven exact replacements match design.md without unrelated source changes (src/core/templates/workflows/explore.ts:32-35; src/core/templates/workflows/propose.ts:75,114). Saved candidate dialogues demonstrate clarification, evidence-based revision, bounded use of local success and direct-Propose readiness (.xirang/changes/intent-solution-feasibility/evidence/dialogues.json:31-169). RC1 is supported by actual discovery, source reads and function execution (evidence/tool-transcripts.json:43-185); RC2 by a real Experimenter handoff, nested execution returning BLOCKED/exit 3, subsequent evidence inspection and withheld design confirmation (evidence/tool-transcripts.json:610-774,788-1013, relative to the same Change directory). Managed surfaces agree with their sources (.xirang/references/xirang-explore-supperpowers-style.md:9-12; .pi/skills/xirang-propose/SKILL.md:120,159; test/core/templates/skill-templates-parity.test.ts:85-95). Independently reran the template and installation suites: 19 files and 246 tests passed. The explicitly designated one-time behavioral evidence is adequate for this scoped prompt change; its disclosed limits remain applicable (evidence/verification.md:38-44,58-64). HEAD remained unchanged throughout review; the pre-existing untracked .quality.json was not used as implementation evidence or modified.

opt.reason: 本次实现为用户逐字确认的七处提示词替换及既有生成同步，没有运行时算法或资源路径改动。独立 Review 已通过，现有对照未证明进一步改写能带来收益，因此不开展额外优化；未产生需要 incremental 或 supplemental Review 的优化改动或修复。

seal.testScope: 19 个模板与安装测试文件、246 项测试，主 Agent 与独立 Reviewer 均实际运行通过；TypeScript 编译、源码 ESLint、LSP diagnostics 和 Change validation 通过；另有 8 段26轮对话及可查事实调查、Experimenter 实际交接与 BLOCKED 结果消费的一次性工具证据。
seal.assessment: G1–G4 和 RC1–RC2 已完成。最新 full-change Review 为 PASS，覆盖 Completeness、Correctness、Coherence、Cleanliness，首次证据不足的 FAIL 历史保留。七处源码与批准原文一致，生成工作面一致；Review 后没有实现改动，不执行额外 Opt，也没有需要追加的 incremental/supplemental Review。有限样例支持候选版在所测范围内正确，不证明相对提升或普遍稳定性；工具夹具未验证真实供应商性能。可进入 Archive 的独立门禁。
